messages:
Olivia CSM: Hi team — Lockridge sent a vendor security questionnaire this morning, looks like SOC2 + DPA follow-ups. They want answers by EOD Thursday. attaching link: https://files.example.com/qry/lockridge-2026.pdf
Ravi Sec: copying through. can we get an evidence matrix? I can handle SOC2 control mappings if someone exports the questionnaire to CSV.
Julian AE: I can pull event logs & dataflow diagrams. which regions do they care about? they flagged EU residency in the form.
Olivia CSM: EU only for customer PII. also asked about key management & whether we offer HSM. needs example DPA clause text.
Marta PM: HSM is supported via our KMS integration but for Private deploys only. I can draft plain-language answers for standard plans.
Ravi Sec: For hosted customers we use cloud KMS, we have a vendor list. I'll paste the short blurb: `Hosted: cloud-kms (AES-256), keys managed by vendor, customer-specific keys via KMS on Dedicated/Private.`
Olivia CSM: @Ravi Sec please add link to the vendor list and any SOC2 evidence paths.
Ravi Sec: added: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026/ and referencing control IDs in the questionnaire. Also note: incident response runbooks are redacted; we provide summary only.
Julian AE: done export -> https://short.link/lockridge-answers-csv
Legal Bot: FYI legal needs to review the DPA clause re: subprocessors. @Marta PM can you escalate to Legal by EOD?
Marta PM: will escalate, looping in @Nora Legal. target: review by Wednesday noon.
Olivia CSM: Timeline agreement with customer: we'll send draft answers by Wed afternoon, final by Thu EOD. @Julian AE thanks for the logs.
Onboard-Bot: Reminder scheduled: create task `Q-2178 Lockridge questionnaire` assigned to Olivia CSM due 2026-03-25
Olivia CSM: thanks everyone — marking this thread as high priority. reactions: :thumbsup:
